incidents.name: GFA reward contract unprotected mint/claim
incidents.notes: The GFA reward contract exposes unauthenticated functions (selectors 0x5f7938f1 and 0x3890ec92) that credit and release arbitrary GFA amounts to the caller, which the attacker then sold into the GFA/BUSD pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xbCbCb0e7E28414e084c4a40C1cCC30B75629a7DE created 2024-04-13T16:06:54Z by 0x970be9ac13acc788dae720c1078cd09b11fa1407, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x0740100ad48d22bc648901520a313b46557f8ada; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
